item.title: Bees get revenge on Fremont with 58-47 road win
item.description: The Box Elder High School boys basketball team picked up an important region win last Friday as they topped Fremont, 58-47, on the road, in their only game of the week. item.title: High speed, likely fog contributed to I-15 accident that claimed life of Riverdale man
item.description: A 22-year-old Weber County man was killed early Thursday morning in a crash on Interstate 15 in Box Elder County that investigators believe occurred during dense fog conditions. item.title: Hepatitis A cases being investigated
item.description: The Bear River Health Department announced last week it was investigating a Hepatitis A outbreak in Cache and Box Elder counties, with three cases identified in the five days leading up to the announcement on Wednesday. As of Monday, no new cases had been reported. item.title: Nominees sought for chamber awards
item.description: Nominations are now open for the Box Elder Chamber of Commerce’s annual awards, which will be presented at the chamber’s banquet on Friday, April 24, at the Box Elder County Fairgrounds. item.title: SenaWave fiber granted franchise
item.description: The Box Elder County Commission approved an ordinance and related agreement Wednesday authorizing SenaWave to operate a fiber telecommunications utility within the county. Brian Papworth, with SenaWave, told commissioners the nonexclusive franchise agreement allows the company to construct and maintain fiber infrastructure in county rights-of-way under a 10-year agreement with renewal options. item.title: Fees waived for conservation fair
item.description: The Box Elder County Commission approved a request to waive the rental fee for the fine arts building at the county fairgrounds to host a conservation fair on April 2, 2026. item.title: Water plan to help county, cities navigate water issues in the face of coming growth
item.description: The Box Elder County Commission on Jan. 28 unanimously adopted a comprehensive, countywide water master plan, approving a 238-page technical document intended to guide long-term planning for water supply, infrastructure and growth.
